speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your medical history in detail, specifically focusing on when you first noticed your gait and limb ataxia, and whether these symptoms are progressive or episodic.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of looking "drunk" and feeling clumsy suggest ataxia, but I need to know if these symptoms have been getting worse over time or if they come and go. Also, do you have any known conditions like diabetes, autoimmune disorders, or previous strokes, and have you noticed any numbness or weakness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
